title: Practice 7: за-: behind, and dropping in

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: ___ (завести / заводить — to take, to bring, to lead) я с ним знакомство.
exercises.why: **завести́** — **заводи́ть** — to take, to bring, to lead; to get, to procure, to acquire, to buy. **завезти́** — **завози́ть** — to take (to a place), to drop off (at a place); to supply, to deliver. **зале́зть** — **залеза́ть** — to climb up (finished action); (also figurative) to get into, to scramble. — DLI, Lesson 63.  ·  From Максим Горький, «Заметки из дневника. Воспоминания».
exercises.context: завести́** — **заводи́ть — to take, to bring, to lead; to get, to procure, to acquire, to buy.

exercises.q: И ко мне ___ (заходить / зайти — to go, to come in, to call, to drop in).
exercises.why: (b) Dropping in on somebody or stopping by at a certain place: заходить, зайти — в магазин, на почту, к учителю. (c) Dropping in or stopping by to fetch something or someone — заходить, зайти за + Instr.: Я зайду за вами. — I'll stop by to pick you up. — DLI, Lesson 63.  ·  From Максим Горький, «Жизнь Матвея Кожемякина».
exercises.context: (b) Dropping in on somebody or stopping by at a certain place: заходить, зайти — в магазин, на почту, к учителю.

exercises.q: ___ (заходить / зайти — to go, to come in, to call, to drop in) же ко мне.
exercises.why: The prefix "за-" implies the following meaning: (a) Getting (disappearing) behind something — заходить, зайти за + Acc.: Солнце заходит за облака. — DLI, Lesson 63.  ·  From Михаил Арцыбашев, «У последней черты».
exercises.context: The prefix "за-" implies the following meaning: (a) Getting (disappearing) behind something — заходить, зайти за + Acc.: Солнце заходит за облака.

exercises.q: С его умом, да ___ (залететь / залетать — to fly) далеко, да и боже избави!
exercises.why: Movement deep into something, at a great distance (inside, upwards or downwards): Мяч залетел на крышу дома. — The ball flew onto the roof of the house. — в / на / за + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst.. **за-** (temporal) — Beginning of multidirectional movement, with multidirection verb of motion — Она забегала по комнате. — She started running around the room. — по + dat.. **зайти́** — **заходи́ть** — to go (to see), to come in (to see, etc.), to call, to drop in; to pick up, to fetch. — Wikipedia, «Russian grammar» (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Russian_grammar#Verbs_of_motion, CC BY-SA 4.0)  ·  From Денис Фонвизин, «Недоросль».
exercises.context: Movement deep into something, at a great distance (inside, upwards or downwards): Мяч залетел на крышу дома. — The ball flew onto the roof of the house. — в / на / за + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst..

exercises.q: Но я ___ (забежать / забегать — to run ahead, to run before someone) вперед.
exercises.why: **за-** (temporal) — Beginning of multidirectional movement, with multidirection verb of motion — Она забегала по комнате. — She started running around the room. — по + dat.. **зайти́** — **заходи́ть** — to go (to see), to come in (to see, etc.), to call, to drop in; to pick up, to fetch. **зае́хать** — **заезжа́ть** — to call in on the way; to drive into. **залете́ть** — **залета́ть** — to fly (in, into); to fly (as high as), to go up (as far as), to fly (as far as), to fly (behind, beyond). — DLI, Lesson 63.  ·  From Владимир Короленко, «История моего современника».
exercises.context: за- (temporal) — Beginning of multidirectional movement, with multidirection verb of motion — Она забегала по комнате. — She started running around the room. — по + dat..

exercises.context: за- — Movement behind an object; stopping off on the way — Старушка зашла за угол и исчезла. — The old woman walked behind the corner and disappeared.
